repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate incorrectly re-executes the pre-cycle actions (Valve.Close and SendMail) in the `else` branch of a periodic wrapper. The IR specifies that the cycle body (SendMail only) should repeat every 1 minute, while the Valve.Close action is a one-time effect before the cycle starts. F2 shows the IR emitted only `SendMail` at 60000ms, whereas the candidate emitted both `valve.close` and `SendMail`.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the `else` branch entirely. The `valve_close` call is kept in the initial phase (lines 5-6) as required by the `wait...call...cycle` sequence. The `else` block is replaced with `break` to ensure the script terminates after the initial phase completes, preventing the periodic re-execution of the pre-cycle action.
